import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import NdBSpline
from scipy.interpolate import BSpline

# Build a simple 1-D NdBSpline
t = [np.array([0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1])]
k = (2,)
c = np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
bsp = NdBSpline(t, c, k)
# In 1.16.3, .c was a mutable instance attribute
bsp.c = np.array([4.0, 5.0, 6.0])
